mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendances (enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, status, remarks) VALUES (#{enrollmentId}, #{lectureDate}, #{period}, #{status}, #{remarks})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendances SET status = #{status}, remarks = #{remarks}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, e.id as enrollment_id, u.name as student_name, c.name as course_name, COALESCE(a.lecture_date, #{date}) as lecture_date, COALESCE(a.period, 1) as period, a.status, a.remarks FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN attendances a ON e.id = a.enrollment_id AND a.lecture_date = #{date} WHERE l.id = #{lectureId} ORDER BY u.name ASC, a.period ASC

SELECT er.id, er.enrollment_id, c.name AS course_name, u.name AS student_name, u.login_id AS student_no, er.lecture_date, er.period, er.reason, er.status, er.reject_reason, er.attachment_original_name, er.attachment_content_type, er.attachment_size FROM excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE l.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId}) AND er.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY er.created_at ASC

SELECT er.id, er.enrollment_id, c.name AS course_name, u.name AS student_name, u.login_id AS student_no, er.lecture_date, er.period, er.reason, er.status, er.reject_reason, er.attachment_original_name, er.attachment_content_type, er.attachment_size FROM excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE l.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN er.status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, er.updated_at DESC, er.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id SET er.status = #{status}, er.reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, er.updated_at = NOW() WHERE er.id = #{requestId} AND l.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendances (enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, status, remarks) SELECT enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, 'EXCUSED', reason FROM excuse_requests WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'APPROVED' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'EXCUSED', remarks = VALUES(remarks), updated_at = NOW()
